declaredBreaks.reason: The unshipped documents-flag API now uses schema version 1 with ID-free ordered cells. Experimental clients must replace ID-based cell edits with complete content plus baseVersionUuid and query charts by zero-based cellIndex plus versionUuid. Earlier experimental Document payloads and persisted versions are not supported; no compatibility migration is provided.
